value.text:
The user wants me to act as Evidence Critic and check each claim against the cited evidence. I need to flag only factual problems: overstatements, wrong numbers/dates/suppliers, causes not stated, products/NDCs not in evidence. Reasonable conclusions from cited facts are supported.

Let me examine each claim:

Claim 1: investigator: "Our package NDC 62135-827-84 is not on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [search-shortage-24]

Evidence says: "Searched this run's FDA shortage list snapshot for our package NDC 62135-827-84 and product 62135-827: not on the list."

Matches exactly. Supported.

Claim 2: investigator: "Current stock of 164 units covers only 5.9 days at 27.9 units per day." Cited: [stock-24]

Evidence says: "albuterol ALBUTEROL SULFATE 1.25 mg/3mL (Chartwell RX, LLC, NDC 62135-827-84, ANDA076355): 164 units on hand, 27.9/day over 30 days, 5.9 days of cover"

Matches exactly. Supported.

Claim 3: investigator: "No ongoing recall for this NDC." Cited: [search-recall-24]

Evidence says: "Searched this run's FDA ongoing-recall snapshot for our package NDC 62135-827-84 and product 62135-827: no ongoing recall."

Matches. Supported.

All claims appear supported. No factual problems. So unsupported list empty.

I must reply with JSON: {"unsupported":[]}.</think>{"unsupported":[]}
